content: GitHub-style path collapse: pure Go algorithm. TreeNode{Name, Children, IsDir, Path, Status}. collapseChain: if IsDir && len(Children)==1 && Children[0].IsDir, merge Name=parent/child, Children=grandchildren. Repeat recursively bottom-up. No external library needed. Trigger: single-child dir chains. Stop at files or dirs with 0 or 2+ children.
